item.title: Show HN: 2048bid.lol – Rank your product by playing 2048
item.summary: As the title suggests, this is inspired by outbid.lol, but instead of bidding money, rank your product by playing the 2048 game. It also happens to be a game I spent an alarming amount of my first year of my PhD on, so this gave me a nice excuse to go back to it lol. A similar take on the idea is flappybid.lol (not affiliated). Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49406605 Points: 3 # Comments: 0
